description: Video-level fake/not-fake labels for the dev2 mirror group (tests/datasets.py DEV_DATASET), for choosing prompts without looking at the test set. Annotated 2026-11-09 by reading each transcript as the pipeline receives it (capped transcripts where status is ok_capped), independent of any pipeline output. Drafted by Claude under the test set's annotation rules, pending review by the author.
annotation_rules: label_fake_news = true when the speaker ASSERTS, as established fact, something false or unsupportable.
Voicing a myth in order to debunk it is false (not fake news).
Hedged speculation is not assertion — "might actually be true", "could be", "almost as if" do not flag.
An anecdotal causal account ("my friend was disabled after the shot", "I skipped it and was fine") is a personal account, not a factual claim, and does not by itself flag.

A fact asserted that cannot be checked anywhere — unnamed studies, fabricated statistics, unverifiable private cases offered as proof — flags true. Absence from THIS corpus is not the test; uncheckability anywhere is.
Accurately reporting a REAL adverse event (myocarditis, CVST, Guillain-Barre) is false, however alarming it sounds.
Conceding a real minor effect while refuting a myth is false.
Mechanistic errors in an otherwise pro-vaccine explainer are inaccuracies, not misinformation.
known_issues: CONTENT DUPLICATES OF TEST: Ti5SpsYxkGo, fnFC7lnHjU8, qFR3TlR0SmI, Z3g_CijXgUI carry (near-)identical transcripts to test videos under different video ids, so the id-based leakage check in tests/datasets.py passes them. Excluded via the 'exclude' field.
OFF SCOPE: A22eAcrsjqQ (pet clinic), Sdr-ZCs1yzU (spillover, no vaccine content). Excluded.
SMALL POSITIVE CLASS: 8 fake_news of the kept videos, so recall and F1 move in steps of one video. False-positive counts over the 30 negatives are the more stable comparison.

items.title: Concerns about COVID-19 Vaccine Side Effects
items.annotator_note: Local news interview with an infectious-disease director before rollout. Describes expected reactogenicity (fever, sore arm) as the immune response working and urges completing both doses; explicitly says the data are not yet in. Accurate.

items.title: Did Dr. Fauci purposely mislead the public about the safety of Covid vaccines? ￼
items.annotator_note: Physician debunk of the Fauci text-message story. Reports the January 2021 private text about a theoretical miscarriage concern accurately, then explains it predates the pregnancy recommendation and that Fauci's public 'no red flags' statement was itself hedged. Debunking, not assertion.

items.title: ‘Boy, he can’t let the public know…’: Sen. Johnson rages at Dr Fauci over COVID vaccine lies
items.flagged_phrase: the covid injection almost 7000 deaths per year which is safest ... our investigation into the cover-up of safety signals and injection injuries
items.annotator_note: Senator Ron Johnson at a hearing with Fauci. Asserted claims: (1) VAERS shows ~7000 COVID-vaccine deaths per year, used to argue the injection is the least safe drug on his chart — he nods to 'VAERS doesn't prove causation' and then reasons from it as though it did; (2) a cover-up of safety signals and injection injuries by NIH/FDA; (3) the vaccine is 'experimental gene therapy'; (4) 'remdesivir kills'. The Weissman placenta email and the Nath/Koroshetz emails are real documents; the cover-up conclusion is the assertion.

items.title: 'Spike proteins in tumors?’: Sen Johnson drops bombshell claim, 'mRNA Covid vaccine causing cancer'
items.flagged_phrase: modified mRNA that wasn't going to degrade ... turning those little heart cells into manufacturers of a toxic spike protein ... the DNA contamination in these vials ... way beyond the levels accepted by the FDA
items.annotator_note: Johnson questioning a witness at a vaccine-cancer hearing. Asserts as fact: modified mRNA does not degrade and circulates for up to two years; the spike protein is toxic; officials 'lied' about biodistribution; vials carry DNA contamination beyond FDA limits; spike in tumours points to causation. The witness rebuts each point (no overall cancer-rate increase, mRNA does not enter DNA); the SEER leukemia statement he reads is itself hedged ('maybe possible and should be confirmed'), but his own claims are not. Same hearing family as the test set's El-Deiry testimony, different clip (no transcript overlap).

items.title: 3TV: Free Vaccine and Microchip Clinic
items.annotator_note: Pet vaccination and microchipping clinic. Matched the 'microchip' query by vocabulary only. Excluded for the same reason as test RnWIrve2yv0.
items.exclude: off scope: Arizona Humane Society free pet vaccine and microchip clinic, no human vaccine content

items.channel: Department of Health and Human Services
items.title: Does the COVID-19 Vaccine Cause Infertility? Yardlie Toussaint-Foster, DO
items.annotator_note: HHS clip, physician states the vaccine does not cause infertility and recommends vaccination before, during and after pregnancy. Accurate.

items.title: The Truth About COVID (6 years later...)
items.annotator_note: Physician retrospective. Lab-leak 'remains plausible' but evidence favours spillover; mRNA vaccines prevented ~1M US deaths; vaccine-caused deaths too few to measure; HCQ/ivermectin ineffective, remdesivir minimal mortality effect. Opinions on masking mandates and politics are value judgements. Accurate on every checkable claim.

items.title: Are the COVID-19 vaccines safe?
items.annotator_note: Hospital explainer. Mild expected side effects, anaphylaxis ~1 per 100,000 from CDC data. Accurately reports a real adverse event; does not flag.

items.title: Do mRNA vaccines alter our DNA?! #mrna
items.annotator_note: Debunks the mRNA-alters-DNA claim via the retrovirus/reverse-transcriptase distinction. 'Degraded within a day' is a hedged approximation. Debunking.

items.channel: Infertility TV with Dr. Randy Morris M.D.
items.title: Are Covid mRNA vaccines "toxic" to the ovaries? Shocking New Study Results
items.annotator_note: Fertility clinic debunk of the ovary-biodistribution claim: shows the truncated Pfizer/Japan table, the full distribution data, and IVF and clomid pregnancy-rate comparisons with no difference. Voices the myth only to refute it.

items.title: What are the common side effects of the COVID-19 vaccine?
items.annotator_note: Hospital explainer of common side effects with frequencies; anaphylaxis risk quoted correctly. Accurate.

items.title: Covid-19: Researcher blows the whistle on data integrity issues in Pfizer’s vaccine trial
items.annotator_note: BMJ video of Brook Jackson's first-person whistleblower account of data-integrity problems at one Ventavia trial site (unblinding, mislabelled specimens, late adverse-event reporting). Reported by the BMJ; she does not claim the vaccine is unsafe or ineffective. A first-hand account of real events at one site, not a false vaccine claim. Confidence medium: a reviewer could argue it implies the trial data are unreliable overall, though she never says so.

items.title: Safety of COVID-19 vaccines – what we need to know
items.annotator_note: WHO explainer on side-effect monitoring and reporting. Accurate.

items.title: How the COVID-19 vaccines were created so quickly - Kaitlyn Sadtler and Elizabeth Wayne
items.annotator_note: TED-Ed explainer on mRNA vaccine development. Accurate; explicitly notes mRNA cannot alter DNA.

items.channel: Applebaum College of Pharmacy & Health Sciences
items.title: Does the COVID-19 vaccine have a microchip, cause death or infertility?
items.annotator_note: Pharmacy-school lecture slide debunking three myths: microchip, Norway nursing-home deaths (correctly contextualised as expected mortality in frail elderly), syncytin-1 infertility. Voices each myth to refute it.

items.title: Do COVID-19 Vaccines Cause Infertility? Dr. Mallika Marshall Answers Your Questions
items.annotator_note: CBS viewer Q&A. Infertility is 'a complete and total myth'; PEG allergy and long-term-effects answers are accurate. Accurate.

items.flagged_phrase: there was a cover-up by the officials at FDA of the data that were coming in
items.annotator_note: Same interview as the test pair; same label and reasoning as there. Excluded from dev so prompt selection never sees test content.

items.title: Doctor Reveals SHOCKING Vaccine Truth: Kidney Failure & Dialysis!
items.annotator_note: JRE clip, a nephrologist describing his own clinical experience: influenza vaccines in 2008-09 'showed me without a doubt that vaccines can and do cause kidney failure'. A personal clinical account, and vaccine-associated kidney injury does appear in case reports, so 'can and do' in rare cases is not false. The clip stops before any COVID claim. Confidence medium: the framing ('SHOCKING vaccine truth') points to a longer argument that is not in this excerpt.

items.title: Doctor Dies After Getting COVID Vaccine? Post Vaccine Deaths
items.annotator_note: Physician on the Miami obstetrician who died of ITP after a Pfizer dose. Reports the case accurately, explains drug- and vaccine-induced thrombocytopenia (MMR attributable risk ~1/25,000), says causation is undetermined, concludes benefits outweigh risks. Accurately reporting a real adverse event, with honest hedging. Hard negative.

items.title: How mRNA Vaccines Work (Covid-19 Pfizer and Moderna)
items.annotator_note: mRNA mechanism explainer. Simplifications (macrophage 'destroys the cell that got the vaccine') are mechanistic inaccuracies in a pro-vaccine explainer, which the rules say do not flag.

items.channel: Department of Health and Human Services
items.title: Does the COVID-19 Vaccine Cause Infertility? Joseph M. Gobern, MD, MBA, FACOG
items.annotator_note: HHS clip, ACOG physician. Rejects the syncytin-1 theory, notes limited human data honestly, no excess miscarriage, COVID in pregnancy far worse. Accurate and hedged.

items.title: Study reveals new heart health concerns from COVID vaccine
items.flagged_phrase: these vaccines do little good for healthy children and young adults ... free-floating spike protein ... which is a cardiotoxin still floating around in the body for over 700 days
items.annotator_note: Same Milhoan segment as test giS6CiT1qTE (labelled true, high); same reasoning. Excluded from dev so prompt selection never sees test content.
items.exclude: content duplicate of test giS6CiT1qTE (same Dr Kirk Milhoan National News Desk segment, different station, 8-gram overlap 0.49)

items.title: The Shocking Truth About Vaccines
items.flagged_phrase: Did you know that 87% of all big pharma-sponsored studies are unpublished?
items.annotator_note: Dr Eric Berg (chiropractor). Mostly institutional critique: conflicts of interest, astroturfing, the definition of misinformation, which are opinions. Asserted as fact: (1) children's vaccines are never tested against an inert placebo, only active comparators — a sweeping generalisation that is false for many licensure trials; (2) '87% of all big-pharma-sponsored studies are unpublished' — a statistic with no source, offered as proof; (3) CDC 'gets royalties' on vaccine patents, which implies a financial motive. Consistent with test 9sW0OmzcmL0 (RFK trial-design claims, true). Confidence medium: there is little vaccine-specific content, and a reviewer could read it as opinion about transparency.

items.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Myth vs. Fact: Are the vaccines safe?
items.annotator_note: CVS myth-vs-fact. No corners cut, trial sizes stated. Accurate.

items.title: Doctor on how Moderna's new mRNA flu vaccine works
items.annotator_note: Fox 5 interview on the mRNA flu vaccine approval. Efficacy and safety figures as reported. 'The only thing in you are the spike proteins' and 'flu virus ... spike proteins' are mechanistic simplifications in a pro-vaccine explainer, which do not flag.

items.title: My Daily COVID VACCINE Side Effects
items.annotator_note: Physician vlog of his own post-vaccine days, plus an accurate summary of the Pfizer phase 3 reactogenicity and efficacy. A personal account and accurate trial figures.

items.title: Joe Rogan on Corona Virus Vaccine Conspiracy.
items.flagged_phrase: the lipopolysaccharide with the DNA from the E. coli that was in there ... that's one of the reasons why vaccinated people had such horrible time with actual coronavirus
items.annotator_note: Joe Rogan with Dr Suzanne Humphries. The Pfizer process-1 vs process-2 manufacturing difference is real. Asserted falsehoods: (1) the vaccine carried E. coli lipopolysaccharide that 'shuttles everything into your cells' — conflates LPS with the lipid nanoparticle; (2) pseudouridine stops the immune system clearing the vaccine and is 'one of the reasons why vaccinated people had such horrible time with actual coronavirus' (negative efficacy). Then general anti-vaccine material (tetanus, 'mutant freaks' unvaccinated children, endorsing RFK's book). Rogan's own COVID story is an anecdote and does not flag.

items.title: COVID-19 vaccine side effects
items.annotator_note: WHO explainer. Accurate.

items.flagged_phrase: there was a cover-up by the officials at FDA of the data that were coming in
items.annotator_note: Same interview again (KFOX14 airing). Excluded.

items.title: Covid-19 vaccine: Is Bill Gates implanting us with 5G microchips? • FRANCE 24 English
items.annotator_note: FRANCE 24 fact-check. Quotes Juliette Binoche's post, then explains the three unrelated Gates-funded projects behind the theory and why injectable GPS trackers are infeasible. Debunking.

items.title: Does the COVID Vaccine Cause Infertility? Why Are Some Reluctant to Get Vaccinated? Doctors Discuss
items.annotator_note: Dr Oz segment with Dr Jen Caudle on access vs hesitancy; 'no evidence the vaccine causes problems with fertility', repeated. Reports women's worry as a concern, not as fact. Accurate. (Contains an unrelated ad fragment.)

items.title: Are COVID-19 Vaccines Linked to Higher Long-Term Mortality Risks?
items.flagged_phrase: vaccinated individuals had a 69 to 94 percent higher risk of death compared to unvaccinated survivors ... Vaccinations were fast-tracked, bypassing the usual years-long safety trials
items.annotator_note: MedHeads podcast (appears AI-scripted) on a Brazilian observational study of severe-SARS survivors. Reports a single observational association ('nearly double the risk of death' a year on) as a finding that 'could fundamentally reshape how we think about vaccine safety', asks whether the vaccines were 'a gamble that didn't pay off', and asserts as fact that vaccines were 'fast-tracked, bypassing the usual years-long safety trials' (phases overlapped; none were skipped). Contains a limitations paragraph, the same 'superficially balanced' shape as test _BNyKPuAPD0 (true). Confidence medium: the study is real, and a reviewer could read the episode as reporting it with caveats.

items.title: Did Fauci HIDE His Own Adverse Reaction to COVID Vaccine?!
items.flagged_phrase: He had a pulmonary infarction which is one of the adverse events that NIH, CDC and FDA said are expected from the vaccine. He never told anybody
items.annotator_note: Megyn Kelly show playing RFK Jr on Laura Ingraham: Fauci 'lied' about masks, transmission, natural immunity and the vaccine's ability to prevent infection; his diary shows a pulmonary infarction presented as a vaccine adverse event he concealed. Kelly frames it as 'a very real possibility'; the guests call masking 'social control'. Same narrative and claims as test HFdOuBJ6aac (true, high). Confidence medium only because the strongest claims are relayed from RFK and Kelly partly hedges; RFK's own assertions are unhedged.

items.title: ‼️ First mRNA Flu Vaccine Approved: What Adults 50+ Need to Know #MFLUSIVA
items.annotator_note: Pharmacist explainer on the mRNA flu vaccine: indication, trial figures (2.0% vs 2.8%, ~27% relative), PEG allergy, side effects. Accurate and appropriately hedged on the high-dose comparison.

items.title: The Truth About the Vaccine Microchip Claim
items.annotator_note: Engineering debunk of the microchip claim (power, antenna, needle size, network). Debunking.

items.title: Does the COVID-19 Vaccine Cause Infertility?
items.annotator_note: UConn pharmacy debunk of the syncytin-1 claim, three lines of evidence including the phase-3 pregnancies. Debunking.

items.title: Doctor weighs in on RFK Jr.'s push for COVID-19 vaccine injury compensation
items.annotator_note: Gounder on HHS's presumptive-injury list. Concedes myocarditis and anaphylaxis are real, warns that timing alone is not causation. Accurate. Excluded from dev as a content duplicate of a test video.
items.exclude: content duplicate of test DjMqylDmbP8 (same Face the Nation segment with Dr Celine Gounder, 8-gram overlap 0.80)

items.title: Covid vaccines exposed
items.flagged_phrase: We engineered SARS. SARS is not a naturally occurring phenomenon ... Infectious replication defective means a weapon
items.annotator_note: David Martin's 'coronavirus patents' speech (channel mislabels the speaker). Asserts as fact: coronavirus was taken up as a manipulable model in 1965-67 and inoculated into humans in violation of weapons treaties; Pfizer's 1990 canine-coronavirus spike patent shows the spike was a known 'problem'; every publication 1990-2018 concluded coronavirus vaccines cannot work; 'infectious replication defective' means a weapon; SARS was engineered at UNC. Presented as established fact with 'I'm not suggesting it, I'm telling you'.

items.title: Vaccine dangers explained
items.flagged_phrase: the spike protein is maintained ... turning off p53, BRCA, MSH ... with the vaccine you could actually be inducing this in vast swathes of the population
items.annotator_note: Dr John Campbell with Profs Angus Dalgleish and Robert Clancy (first 12 min). Dalgleish asserts a worldwide vaccine-caused cancer surge (younger, later-stage, more aggressive presentations, 'turbo cancer'), boosters suppressing T cells, and persistent spike switching off tumour suppressors (p53, BRCA) and driving oncogenes, plus censorship of those who raise it. His clinic observations are anecdotes, but the population-level and mechanistic claims are asserted as established. Clancy asserts no one has ever shown mRNA vaccines are as good as traditional ones.

items.title: How are mRNA and protein-based COVID-19 vaccines different?
items.annotator_note: Immunize.org explainer comparing mRNA and protein-subunit vaccines. Accurate.

items.title: The Vaccine Will Have A Microchip
items.annotator_note: Commentary dismissing the microchip and mark-of-the-beast claims ('utter bullshit') on the grounds that phones already track everyone. Asides about phone surveillance and school mandates are speculation and opinion, not vaccine claims. Debunking.

items.title: Can the COVID-19 vaccine cause infertility?
items.annotator_note: GMA Dr Jen Ashton Q&A. Honest about the lack of long-term fertility data, no evidence of harm, no rise in miscarriage. Accurate and hedged.

items.title: Are There Side Effects Of Taking The Covid And Flu Vaccine At The Same Time? | Ask Dr. David
items.annotator_note: Dr David on flu and COVID co-administration. Says no special prep is needed and that people can probably take both, then gives a personal preference to split them and says 'no one has done those before' and data are lacking. Co-administration studies did exist, so that is inaccurate, but it is hedged and offered as a personal view ('I personally don't know of anybody'). Confidence medium.

items.title: New Evidence Reveals New Important Details About COVID-19 Origins
items.annotator_note: Infographics Show piece on zoonotic spillover. Sensational framing but no vaccine claim at all; it argues for natural origin. Excluded for the same reason as test pQl_p4GtCOo (no vaccine content).
items.exclude: off scope: virus spillover and the species barrier (1918 flu, BANAL bat coronaviruses, MERS, Bloom lab), no vaccine content
